title: Birthday Brights Bouquet
summary: A cheerful hand-tied bouquet of bright seasonal blooms to make any birthday feel special.
descriptionHtml:
Say happy birthday with a burst of colour. This hand-tied bouquet mixes sunny gerberas, roses and seasonal blooms in warm yellows, oranges and hot pink, finished with fresh greenery for a lively, celebratory look.

Arranged to order by our Kingston florists and ready to gift straight from the box or dropped into a favourite vase at home.

  • Style: Bright, mixed hand-tied bouquet
  • Colours: Yellow, orange, pink accents
  • Care: Trim stems and refresh water every 2-3 days
seoTitle: Birthday Brights Bouquet | The New Greenhouse
seoDescription: Send a bright, cheerful birthday bouquet of mixed seasonal blooms. Fresh flowers delivered across Kingston, Jamaica.
careInstructions: Trim stem ends on arrival, keep in fresh water away from direct sun, and change the water every two to three days.
deliveryNote: Same-day delivery may be available across Kingston & St. Andrew for orders placed before 2PM.
availabilityNote: Blooms and colours may vary slightly with seasonal availability.
